annotations.title: Linear-Time O(n) ReDoS-Safe Regular Expression Synthesizer & Tester

description: Synthesizes linear-time O(n) regular expressions free of catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS) and validates them against positive and negative test strings. Use when generating and verifying a regular expression pattern for input validation or lexical parsing; for repairing broken JSON syntax directly without writing custom regexes, use heal_malformed_json instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'description' ('flavor' defaults to 'ecmascript_js'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (50 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

description.description: Natural-language specification of the text pattern to match (e.g. 'RFC 5322 email addresses excluding plus-aliases').

flavor.description: Target regular expression engine syntax; defaults to 'ecmascript_js' when omitted.

name: synthesize_safe_regex

pattern.description: Synthesized regular expression pattern string (without slash delimiters).

redos_safe.description: True when static star-height analysis confirms zero exponential backtracking.

test_results.description: Pass/fail verification results across positive and negative test cases.
